newsitem.title: USA: Primestar repositions via reorganization - paper.
newsitem.headline: Primestar repositions via reorganization - paper.

text.p: Satellite broadcaster Primestar is in a major reorganization which would transform it into a unified company with a national marketing and pricing plan, USA Today said on Tuesday.

Primestar is a satellite company controlled by Tele-Communications Inc, Time Warner, U S West, Comcast Corp and Cox Communications. Under a new arrangement, Primestar would be brought into TCI Satellite Entertainment, the newspaper said.
TCI would own about 38 percent of the equity and Time Warner about 30 percent, USA Today said.
The remaining shares would be split among the company's remaining partners, it said.

A billion-dollar deal between EchoStar Communications and News Corp to build a direct-television satellite hit a snag on Monday. There have been recent reports that New Corp's Rupert Murdoch had approached TCI's John Malone about a possible alliance with Primestar.
A Primestar spokeswoman said she was not aware of any recent conversations with News Corp and a News Corp spokesman would not comment on the speculation.
